I took my pets to renew their vaccination records and was very pleasantly surprised. I knew the clinic because I always passed by it, but I had never taken my pets there before. The woman who greeted us at reception (whose name I forgot, forgive me!) was lovely from beginning to end, the veterinarians were super caring and answered all our questions. It's safe for even the most timid pets, and that made me feel very reassured too.
